text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 429s and latency on prod across /v1/embeddings and spillover to /v1/chat. Automated detection flagged 15% client errors in last 5m. Paging oncall.

sam: ack. I'm on it. Can someone grab the traffic dashboard (live) and list top offending routes + top API keys?

kevin: grabbing. Live metrics: embeddings request rate spiked x6 from baseline, 95th latency for chat up from 120ms -> 900ms, 429 rate concentrated on /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank. Top API keys: acct-42, acct-77, acct-batch-ops.

raj: looks like a customer batch job kicked off heavy embeddings. Support ticket 8342 shows acct-77 running a bulk embed job. They weren't on a dedicated plan.

sam: ok, initial mitigation plan:
- Apply per-route temporary quota reductions to embeddings for non-dedicated tenants
- Increase routing weight for fallback smaller embedding model for background jobs
- Apply a soft cap on chat to protect latency-sensitive calls
- Temporarily disable rerank endpoint (non-critical) if needed

marta: agree. We should document every change in this thread for postmortem.

sam: executing per-route quota tweak now. Using admin API.

sam (command):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/apply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "scope":"tenant:public",
    "overrides":[
      {"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit_per_minute":600},
      {"route":"/v1/chat","limit_per_minute":3000},
      {"route":"/v1/rerank","limit_per_minute":100}
    ],
    "reason":"emergency throttling to protect latency-sensitive chat" 
  }'
```

kevin: applied. Admin returned 200. Observability shows embeddings traffic dropped ~45% within 30s.

sam: next, traffic shaping: route non-dedicated embedding calls to the smaller-embed model as a background fallback. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/routes/patch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "route":"/v1/embeddings",
    "policy":"split",
    "buckets":[
      {"selector":"tenant:dedi", "weight":0.9, "model":"embed-large"},
      {"selector":"tenant:public","weight":0.8,"model":"embed-small"}
    ],
    "reason":"reduce token cost and KV pressure during spike"
  }'
```

raj: putting a temporary feature flag to disable rerank for public tenants to free up capacity.

raj (command):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/featureflag" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"feature":"rerank","enabled":false,"scope":"tenant:public","ttl_seconds":7200}'
```

kevin: rerank disabled for public tenants. No immediate spike in errors observed other than initial 429 tail.

sam: support-bot, please message top-affected customers with an advisory and temporary quota bump option for paid tenants.

support-bot: Messaging acct-77 and acct-42 with canned note + escalation path. Draft:
"We observed elevated errors/latency on embeddings; we've applied temporary throttles and a fallback model. If you need immediate quota for a critical job, reply to this thread and we'll coordinate a short-term bump."

marta: quick customer impact assessment: approx 18 customers saw >=15% error rate; two enterprise customers (acct-77 and acct-22) reported production degradations. No SLA breach yet but risk rising.

sam: rolling back any unsafe change requires approval. For now keep throttles in place. I'll start collecting histograms for the postmortem.

kevin: metrics showing chat 95th latency back to 210ms after embeddings throttles. Overall 429s down to baseline ~0.5%.

marta: oncall handoff: Sam -> Marta in 35 mins. Sam, please summarize current state and outstanding actions before handoff.

sam: summary for handoff:
- Root cause: large unthrottled bulk embeddings workload from public tenants causing KV/backplane saturation and cascade into chat latency.
- Actions taken:
  1) Applied per-route quotas: embeddings reduced for public tenants; chat soft cap to preserve latency; rerank limited.
  2) Traffic shaping: public tenants routed to embed-small model (80% weight) to reduce heavy KV pressure.
  3) Disabled rerank for public tenants temporarily.
  4) Support notified top-affected customers and offered quota bumps to paid customers.
- Current status: errors down, latency improving, monitoring alerts in watch. No broader impact to dedicated customers.
- Outstanding: follow up with acct-77 to understand job patterns; consider permanent per-route default quotas and better knob for background batch jobs.

marta: got it. I'll take ownership at handoff + continue to monitor for 2 hours. If errors resurface, immediate plan is to tighten embeddings further and consider stricter per-key burst limits.

sam: handing off -> @marta. Oncall-bot, assign owner.

oncall-bot: @marta is now on-call owner for this thread. :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks. I'll keep thread updated. Also proposing a short-term config change to add a per-key rolling window for embedding token bursts: 100k tokens per 10m for public tenants. If you want, I can push a tentative rule now (will notify here).

kevin: please do it. This will prevent repeat spikes from batch jobs.

marta (command):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/quotas/keys" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"selector":"tenant:public","route":"/v1/embeddings","rolling_tokens":100000,"window_seconds":600,"reason":"temporary burst protection"}'
```

marta: rule applied. I'll schedule a 30m check in. If stable, we'll start drafting a post-incident RFC for automatic per-route policies (embeddings vs chat vs rerank) and admin UX for quick emergency quotas per-route.

sam: thanks all. leaving notes for postmortem: show exact revert timeline, customer notifications, and config diffs. Closing on my side — handing to Marta.

support-bot: Notified customers; created internal ticket #INC-2026-493 with logs attached.

marta: taking over. I'll post an interim incident summary to #incidents in 30m and start the RCA thread after stability window.

kevin: nice work. :thumbsup:
